method: Read existing exact-commit logs and Git source only. Five same-name tests have one exact '.. ok' line in each job. Function-body bytes from declaration through closing brace were hashed and compared. No project execution, rerun, remote write or source edit.

cases.assertions: Snapshot starts sequence/penalty at zero; success advances sequence/events; failure advances sequence/penalty; rotating merge preserves sequence 2, penalty 1 and two events.
cases.limits: In-memory actor-snapshot example only; no persistent transaction, multiple Unknown or concurrent merge.

cases.assertions: Admission key, payload MAC and identity digest have length 32; computed shard is in [0,64); lock ID is nonzero.
cases.limits: One deterministic material example; despite the name this does not statistically prove shard distribution or exercise storage admission.

cases.assertions: Three finite proof cases reject missing/already-used challenge context, expired challenge and an unfinished hard cooldown.
cases.limits: A finite pure evaluator test, not an exhaustive property sweep or database rollback/restart proof.

cases.assertions: A solved memory challenge verifies once; replay returns an error containing already used.
cases.limits: In-memory one-use path only; no durability, multi-process race or new coordinator correctness.

cases.assertions: A lazily constructed pool is explicitly closed; verify_or_allow returns an error within a one-second Tokio timeout instead of allowing.
cases.limits: No live database connection/SQL is exercised. This proves the closed-pool fail-closed regression, not real SQL failure/commit behavior.

source_change_boundary.exact_change: Only adds pub mod admission_execution; and pub mod admission_transaction;. The selected property test body is byte-identical and shifts from line358 to360.
source_change_boundary.important_limit: The production src/abuse.rs implementation changed between commits. Same defining test-file/body bytes are not a claim that all dependencies or product source are identical. Dual passes establish only the selected regression assertions.

new_test_boundary.service_note: src/services/message_admission.rs already existed at Stage1, but the six current service/witness test names were not present in that earlier job.
new_test_boundary.claim: The 51 current coordinator/harness/service tests are after-only evidence; none is labelled before passed. The five older regressions here are a separate compatibility sample.

separate_evidence_tracks.established_here: Five selected unchanged test bodies passed at both exact commits; assertions and limits above.

separate_evidence_tracks.track: Stage1 eleven-model cases versus current Rust
separate_evidence_tracks.limit: This is a separate model-to-implementation comparison. Earlier model11 records cannot be equated with the new Rust coordinator tests by name, job success or count; use separately bound input/expectation/source evidence.

separate_evidence_tracks.track: Saved record to replay and independent reader
separate_evidence_tracks.limit: Exact saved input/output, source identity, independent verification and replay equality need their own record. Neither these five tests nor a successful Rust test job establish fixed82 record/replay or v2-reader tamper rejection.

excluded: Ignored database tests, unrelated namespaces and historical summary counts are not counted as passes. No whole-Stage2 acceptance or live SQL/wire/outer-ownership conclusion is drawn.
privacy: Ten selected public CI test-status lines and source hashes/links only; no full raw log or credentials.
